title: Circumcision and Passover at Gilgal

questions.question: What happened to the kings of the Amorites and Canaanites when they heard about the Jordan crossing?
options: Their hearts melted and there was no longer any spirit in them
questions.correctAnswer: Their hearts melted and there was no longer any spirit in them
questions.explanation: Joshua 5:1 (ESV): "...their hearts melted and there was no longer any spirit in them because of the people of Israel."

questions.question: What did God command Joshua to make to circumcise the people?
questions.explanation: Joshua 5:2 (ESV): "...Make flint knives and circumcise the sons of Israel a second time."

questions.question: Why did the people need to be circumcised?
options: Those born in the wilderness had not been circumcised
questions.correctAnswer: Those born in the wilderness had not been circumcised
questions.explanation: Joshua 5:5 (ESV): "...but all the people who were born on the way in the wilderness... had not been circumcised."

questions.question: What ceased the day after they ate the produce of the land?
questions.explanation: Joshua 5:12 (ESV): "And the manna ceased the day after they ate of the produce of the land..."

questions.question: Who did Joshua meet near Jericho?
options: The commander of the army of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: The commander of the army of the Lord
questions.explanation: Joshua 5:14 (ESV): "And he said, 'No; but I am the commander of the army of the Lord. Now I have come.'"

questions.question: What does the name "Gilgal" signify in this chapter?
options: Scanning away / Rolling away the reproach of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: Scanning away / Rolling away the reproach of Egypt
questions.explanation: Joshua 5:9 (ESV): "...This day I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you. And so the name of that place is called Gilgal to this day."

questions.question: At what location were they circumcised?
questions.explanation: Joshua 5:3 (ESV): "So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the sons of Israel at Gibeath-haaraloth."

questions.question: When did they keep the Passover?
options: On the fourteenth day of the month at evening
questions.correctAnswer: On the fourteenth day of the month at evening
questions.explanation: Joshua 5:10 (ESV): "...they kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening..."

questions.question: What did the Commander of the Lord's Army tell Joshua to do?
options: Take off your sandals from your feet, for the place is holy
questions.correctAnswer: Take off your sandals from your feet, for the place is holy
questions.explanation: Joshua 5:15 (ESV): "Take off your sandals from your feet, for the place where you are standing is holy."

questions.question: What did the Israelites eat on the day after the Passover?
options: Unleavened cakes and parched grain from the land
questions.correctAnswer: Unleavened cakes and parched grain from the land
questions.explanation: Joshua 5:11 (ESV): "And the day after the Passover, on that very day, they ate of the produce of the land, unleavened cakes and parched grain."

questions.question: Why specifically had the previous generation died in the wilderness?
options: Because they did not obey the voice of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Because they did not obey the voice of the Lord
questions.explanation: Joshua 5:6 (ESV): "...because they did not obey the voice of the Lord..."

questions.question: What oath had the Lord sworn to the previous generation?
options: That he would not let them see the land flowing with milk and honey
questions.correctAnswer: That he would not let them see the land flowing with milk and honey
questions.explanation: Joshua 5:6 (ESV): "...the Lord swore to them that he would not let them see the land..."

questions.question: When Joshua asked the Commander, "Are you for us, or for our adversaries?" what was the answer?
questions.explanation: Joshua 5:14 (ESV): "And he said, 'No; but I am the commander of the army of the Lord...'" The answer "No" (or "Neither") implies he is on God's side, not merely a human ally.

questions.question: What is the meaning of Gibeath-haaraloth?
questions.explanation: Gibeath-haaraloth translates to "Hill of the foreskins".

questions.question: Joshua falling on his face illustrates what attitude?
questions.explanation: Joshua 5:14 (ESV): "And Joshua fell on his face to the earth and worshiped..."

key_verse_text: And he said, “No; but I am the commander of the army of the LORD. Now I have come.” And Joshua fell on his face to the earth and worshiped... (ESV)
